signature-cloud.name_th: ช่อคลาวด์ซิกเนเจอร์
signature-cloud.desc: A dreamy cloud of fresh baby's breath, delicately wrapped in our signature ivory paper and finished with a hand-tied ribbon. Soft, timeless, and quietly romantic — a signature expression of Rosewood & Ivy.

signature-white.name_th: ช่อซิกเนเจอร์ไวท์
signature-white.desc: Cream and white blooms gathered in our signature wrapping — quiet, luminous, and impossible to overdo. Our most requested white bouquet, and the one we are known for.

dior-inspired.desc: Our most photographed creation — fresh blooms designed around Dior beauty, from lip products to Miss Dior fragrance. Each piece is composed to order, in the palette and scale you choose.

rose-collection.name_th: คอลเลกชันกุหลาบ
rose-collection.desc: Premium roses in soft blush and garden tones, hand-tied and finished in our signature wrapping. Each stem is chosen for its form and fragrance. A truly luxurious gift that speaks volumes without a single word.

roses-20.name_th: กุหลาบ 20 ดอก
roses-20.desc: Twenty premium roses, hand-tied and finished in our signature wrapping. Generous without being grand — the number for the moments you want to say it properly.

roses-50.name_th: กุหลาบ 50 ดอก
roses-50.desc: Fifty premium roses, hand-tied stem by stem and wrapped in the Rosewood & Ivy signature finish. Full, romantic, and beautifully weighted in the arms.

roses-101.name_th: กุหลาบ 101 ดอก
roses-101.desc: One hundred and one premium roses, hand-tied into a single breathtaking bouquet. This is the one that stops the room — reserved for proposals, milestones, and love that needs no explanation.

roses-bespoke.name_th: ช่อกุหลาบสั่งทำพิเศษ
roses-bespoke.desc: Any colour, any count, any scale. Tell us the moment and we will hand-tie premium roses to match it, finished in signature wrapping and styled entirely around you.

gift-beauty.name_th: ดอกไม้ & บิวตี้
gift-beauty.desc: Fresh blooms arranged around luxury beauty — Dior, Laneige, and the pieces she already loves. Presented in a woven basket or hatbox, curated as one unforgettable gift.

gift-eyewear.name_th: ดอกไม้ & แว่นตา
gift-eyewear.desc: A designer pair, nested into fresh blooms and styled to be opened slowly. Bring us the eyewear or let us source it — we design the arrangement around the piece.

gift-fashion.name_th: ดอกไม้ & แฟชั่น
gift-fashion.desc: Flowers composed around a fashion piece — a scarf, a silk, something chosen with her in mind. The blooms are matched to the palette so the whole gift reads as one.

gift-bags.name_th: ดอกไม้ & กระเป๋า
gift-bags.desc: The bag she has been quietly wanting, presented in a bed of fresh blooms. Designed so the flowers frame the gift rather than compete with it.

gift-more.name_th: ดอกไม้ & อื่น ๆ
gift-more.desc: Jewellery, watches, fine fragrance — whatever the gift, we build the flowers around it. Tell us what is inside the box and we will design the moment it arrives in.

gift-bespoke.name_th: ของขวัญลักซ์ชัวรีสั่งทำพิเศษ
gift-bespoke.desc: A fully custom luxury hamper, built around any gift you choose. Share the occasion, the budget, and the brand — we source, arrange, and finish it entirely by hand.

location.th: กรุงเทพฯ ประเทศไทย

delivery.th: ส่งวันเดียวกันในกรุงเทพฯ

r1.text_th: ช่อเบบี้เบรธสวยมาก ใหญ่กว่าที่คิดและสดมาก เพื่อนร้องไห้เลยตอนที่ได้รับ
r1.text_en: The baby's breath bouquet was absolutely stunning. Bigger than I expected and incredibly fresh. My friend cried when she received it.
r1.author_th: ปิ่ม K., กรุงเทพฯ

r2.text_th: กระเช้า Dior x Rosewood เป็นของขวัญที่สวยที่สุดที่เคยให้มา ทั้งแพ็คเกจจิ้ง ดอกไม้ และผลิตภัณฑ์ — ทุกอย่างสมบูรณ์แบบ
r2.text_en: The Dior x Rosewood gift basket was the most beautiful thing I've ever gifted. Packaging, flowers, products — everything was perfect.
r2.author_th: มินท์ T., สีลม

r3.text_th: สั่งมาสามครั้งแล้ว ทุกช่อใส่ใจและดูเรียบหรู เป็นร้านดอกไม้เดียวที่จะใช้ในกรุงเทพฯ
r3.text_en: I've ordered three times now. Every single arrangement is thoughtful and elegant. This is the only florist I'll ever use in Bangkok.
r3.author_th: เฟิร์น P., เอกมัย
